name: Renovate A House
desc:
You and your friends scored the deal of a lifetime on a ridiculously cheap house! But when you finally arrived to move in... it was a complete disaster. The yard is buried, the floors are filthy, and the walls are completely ruined. Now, it's up to you to roll up your sleeves and turn this broken-down dump into your dream home! 🏚️✨

🎮 How to Play
🍂 Clear the Yard – Pick up, rake, and use powerful leafblowers to clear out massive piles of leaves.
💦 Powerwash – Blast away years of grime and dirt to reveal sparkling clean floors.
🎨 Paint – Grab your brush and give the destroyed walls a fresh coat of paint.
💰 Upgrade Tools – Earn money as you clean to buy better tools so you can work faster!
🏆 Compete – Race against the clock and climb the leaderboards for the fastest map completion time.

Play solo or team up with your friends! 🤝

👍 THUMBS UP FOR MORE UPDATES! 👍

Tags : renovate, cleaning, house, simulator, powerwash, leaf blower, coop, speedrun, adventure, satisfying, teamwork.

llm.loop: rake leaves, powerwash grime and paint walls at a ruined house -> earn money -> buy better tools -> finish faster and climb speedrun leaderboards
llm.objectives: turn the dump into a dream home, fast
llm.instructions: clear the yard, powerwash, paint, upgrade tools; solo or with friends
